title: M5GFX #427: keep clocking a held SDA until a STOP holds (host-level review)

execution.environment: macOS local; clang C++11; no ESP32-C5 hardware; Device Service has 36 profiles and no C5; esp-emulator QEMU backends are esp32s3/esp32c6/esp32/native/raspi3b only

checks.detail: do/while at probe_hardware.inl:31-41; STOP per clock (SCL high, SDA low->high); cap ++i < 10; break on wait_i2c_scl_high failure; SCL held low at entry returns false without clocking
3 call sites (probe_i2c_bus_present recover :55, recover_held_sda_and_resample :90, probe_i2c_ack :129) all run before the master starts any transaction, and each restores pin state afterwards
sh test/board_detect/run.sh at b8f5d89: C++ test programs: 34 passed (exit 0)
same test against develop b48dce0 release_held_sda(): Assertion failed at held_sda_release.cpp:90 (first 0x2D case), exit 134
code/sim_slave.cpp (written for #424) against b8f5d89: 5/5, failures=0 (issue case true/2, all-zero true/8, one-clock true/1, write ACK true/10, stuck SDA false/10)
host model only: a peripheral that never releases SDA returns false after 10 SCL pulses; no such case in the PR's own test
PR #427 checks: catalog, IDF 5.1.6/5.4.3/6.0.2 and Arduino-ESP32 2.0.17/3.1.3 builds for C3/C5/C6/C61/H2/P4/S3 all pass
ToughC5 + UnitNFC and Nesso N1 internal-IMU reset campaigns not reproduced; author's table quoted only
no ESP32-C5 profile and no esp32-c5 emulator backend; C6 profiles exist but a reset that leaves the internal IMU driving SDA mid-byte cannot be injected
TimerCam/PowerHub/Cardputer/VAMeter/StampS3Bat/PaperS3/PaperDIY/UnitC6L/CoreMatrix/CoreP4X/StampP4XHub not tested (author also lists them as unverified)
receiver holding SDA in its ACK slot verified in the host model only

notes: PR left OPEN; one Japanese comment posted; no close, no push to the upstream repository, no code changes to m5stack/M5GFX.
The change matches what was agreed in #424 (per-clock STOP, cap 10 clocks); the only review suggestion is an optional extra test for a peripheral that never releases SDA.
Author's hardware table (ToughC5 0/70, Nesso N1 0/40, StickS3 0/40, CardputerADV 0/40, Tab5 0/40) is quoted, not reproduced here.
